audit_items.proof_trace: `mint_new_whitelist` (the only public path to create a `PackageCallerCap`) requires `&AdminCap`, and `update_permission` (the only path to grant liquidation permission bit 2) also requires `&AdminCap`. The underlying `mint_cap` and `whitelist_mut` are `public(package)`, making them inaccessible outside the protocol package. Initial permission on mint is 0, so every cap starts with no rights until an admin explicitly grants them.
